name: MY ROOM KEY
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. Off the hotel's key rack once he has a room. It locks the wardrobe; kept.

LOOK_AT.say: The key to number three, on a brass tag the size of a saucer, so that no guest may forget whose it is.
repeat: It would open any door in the hotel. I tried it in the wrong one, by accident, and it was delighted.
A key, to a room, with my things in it. I had not expected to find that affecting.

LISTEN_TO.say: It swings against its tag. A small, landed sound.
repeat: A chime against the tuning fork. Flat, naturally.
